an5.97:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ānāpānasatiṃ bhāvento na cirasseva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhati.
an5.97:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu appaṭṭho hoti appakicco subharo susantoso jīvitaparikkhāresu.
an5.97:1.7: appicchakathā …pe… evarūpāya kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an5.97:1.9: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ānāpānasatiṃ bhāvento na cirasseva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhatī’ti.
